sources.title: Holders of Taiwanese passports
sources.publisher: Embassy of the Republic of Serbia in Japan
sources.officialityEvidence: The live page is published on Serbia MFA's official embassy domain and expressly addresses holders of Taiwanese passports seeking entry to Serbia.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Holders of Taiwanese passports need to apply for a visa C (short stay) to be issued a Visa Sticker Form.

sources.title: Special Notice to the Short Term Visitors to Sri Lanka
sources.publisher: Department of Immigration and Emigration, Sri Lanka
sources.officialityEvidence: Sri Lanka's Immigration Department publishes the current short-term visitor notice, last updated 21 August 2026, including its universal pre-arrival ETA requirement.
sources.supportingExcerpt: All foreign nationals are required to obtain an Electronic Travel Authorization prior to their arrival in Sri Lanka.

policies.title: Taiwanese passports: Serbia short-stay visa required
policies.summary: Serbia's Embassy in Japan expressly requires holders of Taiwanese passports to obtain a short-stay Visa C sticker before entry.
conditions: Apply through a Serbian embassy or consulate for the Visa C sticker before travel; the embassy specifies short-stay visitor documentation including a hotel booking or certified invitation.
This excludes work, residence, special documents, conditional third-country visa/residence waivers and final admission.

policies.title: Taiwan ordinary passports: Sri Lanka pre-arrival ETA
policies.summary: Sri Lanka Immigration's current universal short-term visitor instruction requires a pre-arrival ETA for foreign nationals, including ordinary Taiwan passport holders.
conditions: Taiwan is not in the named 40-nationality free-ETA cohort, so the ordinary Taiwan-passport visitor remains subject to Sri Lanka's general ETA rules and applicable fee.
Obtain the ETA before arrival for an ordinary short visit; work, residence, special documents and final admission remain separate.

application.label: Sri Lanka Electronic Travel Authorization
steps: Apply for Sri Lanka's ETA before travel using the ordinary Taiwan passport to be used for entry.
